review.notes: No code fences exist in this OCR, so no fence pass was needed. A digit-sequence sweep of extracted text from all 43 physical PDF pages against the OCR markdown surfaced exactly five absent 3+-digit numbers, all inside dropped footnote URLs, plus the p.1 arXiv:2609.03582 publisher stamp (not body text). All eight printed URL footnotes (pages 4, 6, 7, 9, 31, 32) were dropped by OCR while their superscript markers survived; each footnote body was re-added after the paragraph carrying its marker, matching the printed text verified on rendered bottom strips of all six pages (130 dpi). The PDF prints the product name 'Integrated Multi-satellitE Retrievals' with a mid-word capital E (p.7 and p.32, verified at 300 dpi); OCR split it into 'Multi-satellite E Retrievals' twice. Two figure-internal titles were promoted to markdown headings although the PDF only prints them inside the figure images: the '(a)' panel title of Figure 4 (rendered p.13) and the banner above Figure A.8 (rendered p.38); both demoted to plain text to match how OCR kept the sibling panel titles '(b)'/'(c)'/'(d)' and the other figure-group titles. 39 OCR headings were substring-checked against the PDF text layer; all others match printed headings or captions. Line-level prose proofreading of all 43 pages was not completed within the review budget, hence partial coverage.
